instruction:
Create a new TypeScript module that exports a URL-scheme guard for conference links on calendar grid cards. Export exactly two named consts, no default export.

1) `isJoinableUrl` — a type predicate `(url: string | null | undefined): url is string`. Return false for falsy input. Otherwise `new URL(url)` inside try/catch; return true only when `protocol` is `"http:"` or `"https:"`; return false from the catch.

2) `getJoinableConferenceUrl` — `(conference: GridEvent["conference"]): string | null`. Body: read `conference?.url`, return it UNCHANGED when `isJoinableUrl` passes, else null. Never return `new URL(url).href` — normalization would rewrite the provider's URL.

Import the type with `import { type GridEvent } from "@web/common/types/web.event.types";`. Type-only import; do not import from @core.

Write a TSDoc block above each export explaining WHY (provider-sourced URLs may carry javascript:/data: schemes), in the voice of the EventRepeatIcon.tsx comment supplied in inputs. Arrow-function consts, Biome formatting, double-quoted strings, semicolons. Output the complete file.

The Conference type this guard consumes. url is a string, label is string | null.
Shows conference is nullable AND optional on GridEvent, so the guard must accept null | undefined.

instruction:
Write a bun:test unit-test file for the URL-scheme guard supplied in inputs. No React, no @testing-library, no DOM.

Import `{ describe, expect, it } from "bun:test"` and the two functions from "./event-join-url.util".

describe("isJoinableUrl") — one `it` per row of the behaviour table in inputs, covering all of: https URL true, plain http true, uppercase HTTPS true, javascript: false, data: false, vbscript: false, file: false, protocol-relative "//meet.google.com/x" false, bare "meet.google.com/x" false, empty string false, null false, undefined false.

describe("getJoinableConferenceUrl") — undefined returns null; null returns null; a valid https conference returns the ORIGINAL string (assert with toBe against the same string constant, which pins the no-normalization rule); a javascript: conference returns null.

Cast conference fixtures as needed to satisfy the parameter type. Keep each `it` title a plain descriptive sentence. Output the complete file.

One describe("isJoinableUrl") with a table-driven set of its over the ten rows, plus describe("getJoinableConferenceUrl") covering: undefined -> null, null -> null, { url: "https://...", label: "x" } -> the ORIGINAL string (assert identity with the input string), and { url: "javascript:alert(1)", label: null } -> null.

Implement all four handlers exactly as the handler table specifies. Add the TSDoc block from the contract above the component. Output the complete file.
